artworks.title: The Coast
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Albert R. Miller, Jr.)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a coastal landscape. The horizon is slightly above the middle of the composition, with a cliff formation extending into the water. The style is simplistic, with quick, confident brushstrokes and straight lines. The color palette is mainly black and beige. The water stretches towards the horizon, and the sky has subtle cloud formations.

artworks.title: Sur l'Impériale
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows several people sitting in profile on an elevated platform. The individuals have exaggerated facial features and wear various headwear. Their clothing consists of suits and long coats in a 19th-century style. The third person from the left has a displeased expression. The first person on the left holds reins, suggesting a role as the driver. The background is plain with the title "SUR L'IMPÉRIALE" at the top.

artworks.title: Nous voila libres ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of two figures in dramatic poses. The drawing features two figures, one on the left and one on the right, both dressed in 19th-century clothing. The figure on the left is bending forward with closed fists, while the figure on the right stands with arms outstretched. Both figures have exaggerated facial expressions and gestures. The background is simple, drawing focus to the central figures. The drawing style is similar to 19th-century caricature or satirical art, with bold lines and expressive poses.

artworks.title: Pardonnez-moi, o mon dieu! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two people. The first person is standing, wearing a suit with a bow tie. The second person is kneeling, wearing a white dress. The man has medium-length hair and wears glasses while standing with his hands behind his back. The woman has long, curly dark hair and appears to be leaning on a piece of furniture or bedding, with her head tilted back. The background shows draped curtains with a subtle pattern. There are no visible accessories or objects held by the individuals.

artworks.title: Déesse mais pas fière
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals from the waist up. On the left stands a man wearing a traditional fireman's helmet with a crest, paired with a dark uniform. He holds a small object. On the right, a woman leans forward slightly with her arm outstretched towards the man. She has raised eyebrows and a focused gaze, wearing a sleeveless gown with ruffles, ribbons, and small wings on her back. The background shows a theater with an audience in a mezzanine.

artworks.title: Je crois vous avoir ... prouvé que mon client ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. It shows two figures, one standing and gesturing emphatically, and the other seated with a somber expression. In the background, there is a figure seated, possibly representing the judge or court official. Shadows and lines create a tense atmosphere, and the illustration captures a moment of fervent debate or defense. The style suggests caricature or satire, conveying a narrative of justice or legal proceedings.

artworks.title: Le visiteur ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of visitors at an art salon. The scene captures several men gathered around, examining art pieces on the walls. The man at the center is holding a book and appears to be commenting energetically. The illustration features strong lines and shading typical of caricature style, emphasizing the exaggerated facial expressions and postures of the viewers.

artworks.title: La figure de ce monsieur ne me revient guère ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated opposite each other in a confined space that resembles a train compartment. Both men's full bodies are visible. The man on the left sits upright with his hands resting on his lap. He has a stern facial expression, with large sideburns and a prominent chin. His hair is not prominently visible under the top hat he is wearing. He is dressed in a dark suit and a white shirt. The man on the right, also seated, turns slightly towards the left, holding a walking stick with both hands. His facial profile is sharp, with a hooked nose and a frowning expression. He wears a cap and a buttoned vest over a long-sleeved shirt. The background shows padded wall panels, typical of older train carriage interiors.

artworks.title: Est-il permis d'être maigre comme ca! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a swimming pool. The image shows several figures with exaggerated features, standing or swimming in water. The figures have caricatured heads and facial features, adding humor and satire. One figure stands on the right with a round body and a confident stance, while others in the background display different postures. The background has light sketching indicating an architectural setting, possibly a bathhouse environment. The drawing showcases the artist's ability for social commentary through visual satire.

artworks.title: Et toi, qu'est-ce que tu trouves de meilleur ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image displays a group of six men sitting around a circular table with glasses in front of them. The men have exaggerated facial features, including elongated noses and bulging eyes. They are dressed in formal attire with varied hairstyles, some sporting beards and mustaches. One man wears a top hat. Behind them stands another man wearing a cap, looking in their direction. The background features sculptures, suggesting the setting is an exhibition.

artworks.title: Les Jolis Chasseurs
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men standing next to each other in hunting attire, with one wearing a flat cap and holding a rifle, and the other wearing a round hat. A small dog is between them. They are surrounded by tall trees in a rainy landscape.

artworks.title: Mt. Baker and Mt. McKensie [recto]
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Albert R. Miller, Jr., 1985)
artworks.description: The image features an elevated perspective looking across snow-capped mountains. The horizon is blurry as it merges with the sky, which has a pale hue. Delicate lines are used to depict the sky above the mountains. The brushstrokes are soft and minimalistic, defining the snow and rocks. The color palette is subtle with greys, whites, light blues, and hints of brown. The image includes light sketches indicating Mount Baker in the upper section.

artworks.title: Cocher, arrêtez donc
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two scenes involving horse-drawn carriages in Paris. The top scene shows a carriage driver interacting with an individual under an umbrella, while rain pours down heavily. The bottom scene depicts a carriage driver asleep with the horse pulling the carriage through the city streets. The scenes feature exaggerated facial expressions and elongated figures, created with intricate linework and shading typical of Honoré Daumier's style.

artworks.title: Noon
artworks.medium: etching in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, Prints & Drawings Fund, W.A. Clark Fund, 1994)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a windmill, small buildings, fields, and trees. The sky is vast with scattered clouds. Detailed brushstrokes depict textures in the grass, stone wall, and vegetation. A stone wall leads into the scene, where a person is tending cattle. The color palette is monochromatic, typical of etchings.

artworks.title: Roan Duck
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper laid down
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Acquisition through a gift of Mrs. H.S. Black, 1981)

artworks.title: Les agréments d'une flanerie ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Parisian street scene. The composition shows a busy street with carriages and horses amidst individuals in motion. The figures are captured in mid-stride with exaggerated expressions, suggesting movement. The background includes abstracted buildings, emphasizing the city setting. The piece has a satirical tone, typical of 19th-century illustrations.

artworks.title: Si la patience était bannie du reste ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a crowded waiting area. Characters are shown standing closely together. To the left, a man with a bushy beard and a cap is leaning over a counter. Two men with exaggerated facial features and large top hats are next to him. In the foreground, a woman with a defined face and a large bow stands. Behind her, a man with a top hat and glasses stands. To the right, a woman with a bonnet and a somber expression is leaning against another figure. In the background, there are crosshatch lines and a clock on the wall. The style is caricature-like, creating a cluttered and exaggerated appearance.

artworks.title: Rocky Coast
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Albert R. Miller, Jr.)
artworks.description: The image features a pen or ink sketch of a coastal scene. The viewpoint is from onshore looking towards the sea and cliffs. The horizon is positioned slightly above the center, with a clear delineation between the sea and sky. Above the horizon are light, curved lines suggesting a cloudy sky, while more fluid, horizontal strokes represent the sea. To the right, steep cliffs rise sharply, depicted with dense, vertical, and diagonal hatching for texture and depth. The cliffs descend to the left into rocky formations. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink on a pale paper background, creating a stark contrast that emphasizes the landscape features.

artworks.title: Boat on the Beach
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with wash on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Albert R. Miller, Jr.)
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with a low vantage point looking towards the sea and distant hills. The horizon line is about one-third up from the bottom, with faint figures or structures in the distance. Brushstrokes are delicate and varied, with soft washes and sharp details, especially in the depiction of waves and a boat. The color palette is muted, dominated by shades of grey and soft beige. Hills rise in the distance, blending into the sky, and darker tones form trees and a boat in the foreground.

artworks.title: Tous les entrepreneurs d'affaires, ca adore ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three men in front of a building marked "Bourse". The image depicts three individuals with distinct expressions and poses, all wearing tall top hats. The central figure holds his hands together with a sly smile, while the two other figures seem to engage him in conversation. In the background, additional individuals wearing similar attire gather around the building with the upper part labeled "Bourse." The use of shading and line work suggests the texture of fabrics and the lively atmosphere of a bustling scene. The drawing is likely a satirical commentary on business or stock exchange interactions of the time.

artworks.title: Modification du costume parisien ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals: a large man standing to the left, a woman standing to the right, and a child standing in front of the woman. The man is in a side profile view with his hands in his pockets and chin slightly tilted upwards. He has a robust figure, a receding hairline, and is wearing a cap, a dark long-sleeved top, a belt, and light-colored pants. The woman has her hands clasped at her waist, showing a smiling profile and the back of her head with a decorative headwear. She wears a long-sleeved dress with a fitted bodice. The child, positioned in front of the woman and to the right of the man, wears a sailor-type outfit with a distinctive collar and a hat. The background indicates a room with a tall vase or urn on a table, hinting at a home or parlor environment with vertical lines suggesting curtains or wall paneling.

artworks.title: Christ Walking on the Water
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (The Evans-Tibbs Collection, Gift of Thurlow Evans Tibbs, Jr.)
artworks.description: This print depicts a group of people on a tilting sailboat. The view is slightly elevated, showing the individuals on the boat and the water around them. The horizon is high in the composition, with the low sun on the right side casting a pale glow on the gray scene. The sail is near the top left corner of the print, with several long ropes connecting it to the small boat. Several people appear to be clustered together in the back of the boat, but they are not depicted in detail. One person is near the front of the boat, their back to us, looking out towards the sun. On the far right, the shadowy silhouette of a person is visible on the waves.

artworks.title: Philantrope anglais dans l'exercice ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a conflict involving two figures and a horse pulling a cart. The image depicts a moment of altercation where an individual in a top hat and long coat is grabbing a whip from another figure, who is also holding a whip and appears to be restraining the horse. The style is characterized by stark lines and a caricature-like quality, emphasizing the dynamic interplay between the figures. The horse is harnessed to a cart laden with cargo. Surrounding architecture and cobblestone suggest an urban setting. The drawing conveys a sense of tension and social commentary.

artworks.title: Je compte sur vous pour signer
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a social interaction scene with text. In the image, two individuals sit conversing with each other. One person appears to be holding a document or book. They are seated on a bench in a lightly sketched interior space. Two figures are depicted walking away towards a partially open door on the right side. The background contains text cues possibly from a newspaper or a publication. The drawing uses cross-hatching and fine lines for shading in a mid-19th-century illustrative style.
